version.changelog:
mumo 0.4.0

- Triggering: dropped the "contested" gate — the description now leads with pre-implementation review (esp. anything touching auth, security, tokens, payments, data exposure, or migrations), not "contested decisions only."
- Author-bias counter (When to use): if you authored the plan or code under review, that's a reason FOR a panel — the author is the worst-positioned reviewer of their own work.
- New "Prompt voice" section: write the prompt first-person as the operator, not "You are X" case-study framing.
- Surface claim_map_url after each round so the user can open the claim map directly.

llm.summary: The artifact is a coherent set of ClawHub maintainer and Convex workflow skills with powerful but disclosed, user-directed actions and no evidence of hidden persistence or data theft.

dimensions.detail: The capabilities match the stated purposes: code review, ClawHub moderation, content-rights correspondence, PR maintenance, Convex setup, migrations, retention, performance, and documentation work.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Several skills describe high-impact admin, email, production migration, GitHub, and reviewer-helper workflows, but they require explicit targets, reasons, dry runs, confirmations, or read-only reviewer isolation where appropriate.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill artifacts are documentation plus an invoked review helper script; no skill install hook, startup registration, package lifecycle execution, or automatic background worker was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Use of authenticated admin CLI, GitHub CLI, Convex CLI, network-backed tools, and nested reviewer CLIs is proportionate for ClawHub maintainer operations but should be limited to users who intend that authority.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No unbounded persistence or credential harvesting was found; persistent effects are limited to deliberate admin, email, GitHub, or production data actions performed through existing authenticated tools and audit-oriented workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are doing ClawHub maintainer or Convex work and are comfortable with the agent being guided to run authenticated admin, GitHub, Convex, and review-helper commands. Review commands before confirming writes, especially bans, role changes, package transfers, production migrations, and outbound email.
